look_here_first: Texas annual milkvetch in the Nuttallianus complex with 4–12 flowers per raceme, relatively broad leaflets, and long narrow glabrous pods.

key_traits.label: Family pattern
key_traits.text: Fabaceae/Astragalus: alternate pinnate leaves, papilionoid pea flowers, and legumes; fruit shape, inflation, hairiness, and curvature are especially useful for species ID.

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: glabrous narrow pods about 13–24 mm long

lookalikes.differences: Compared with broad A. nuttallianus, var. pleianthus is the Edwards Plateau/Texas form with more-flowered racemes, broader leaflets, and glabrous narrow pods.

source_credit: Existing Hays Botany species record and scientific source notes; original full record retained in assigned family staging branch
